description: Local business contacts API for AI agents: send a Google Maps search and a location and get up to 8 places as JSON with name, address, category, rating, phone and website, plus the emails, extra phone numbers and Facebook, Instagram and YouTube links found on each place's website. Pay per place in stablecoins; places you paid for but did not get are refunded. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of places wanted, 1 to 8 (default 3). A larger value is lowered to 8 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

location.description: area to search, e.g. "Prague, Czech Republic" (one location per call)

name: maps-contacts
title: Local businesses with emails and phones
